title: First-Order LoRA Training with Phone NPUs
abstract: arXiv:2610.24816v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: On-device fine-tuning lets a large language model (LLM) learn from its user's private data without uploading it. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the trainable parameters, but each first-order training step still multiplies by the frozen base-model weights during the forward pass, activation recomputation, and input-gradient computation. A phone's neural processing unit (NPU) already holds these weights for inference; using it for training also requires computing input gradients, which its inference interface does not support. We present a system that runs all three frozen-weight products on the NPU while keeping the training graph, adapters, and optimizer on the CPU. Its input-gradient kernels reuse the resident weight tiles and the forward dequantizer, avoiding a transposed weight copy and ensuring forward and backward use the same effective weights. translated_title: 使用手机神经处理单元（NPU）进行一阶LoRA训练
translated_abstract: 端侧微调使大语言模型（LLM）能够从用户的私有数据中学习，而无需上传这些数据。低秩适应（LoRA）减少了可训练参数的数量，但每个一阶训练步骤仍需在前向传播、激活值重计算和输入梯度计算过程中与冻结的基础模型权重相乘。手机的神经处理单元（NPU）在推理时已经保存了这些权重；将其用于训练还需要计算输入梯度，而其推理接口并不支持这一操作。我们提出了一个系统，在NPU上运行全部三项冻结权重乘法运算，同时将训练图、适配器和优化器保留在CPU上。该系统的输入梯度内核复用了常驻的权重分块和前向反量化器，避免了生成转置权重副本，并确保前向和反向传播使用相同的有效权重。为保留可用的梯度，系统根据梯度敏感性选择计算精度……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种让手机NPU承担LoRA一阶训练中全部冻结权重矩阵乘法（包括推理接口不支持的输入梯度计算）的系统，通过复用常驻权重分块和前向反量化器，实现了大语言模型在端侧基于私有数据的高效微调。
en_tdlr: The paper presents a system that offloads all frozen-weight matrix multiplications in first-order LoRA training—including input-gradient computation unsupported by NPU inference interfaces—to phone NPUs by reusing resident weight tiles and the forward dequantizer, enabling efficient on-device LLM fine-tuning with private data.
